title: Bonus Chapter: Filo's Mysterious Mystery Labyrinth
text: “Master-sama, Filo can see it now~”
“Hm?”

Master-sama poked his head out of Filo’s carriage to look at the scenery ahead. It was some kind of wasteland, and right in the middle of it there seemed to be a cave. And in front of the cave was a Dragon Hourglass! A whole bunch of people were gathered around the cave doing something.
“So that’s the place…”
“Whatever could it be, I wonder?”

Big Sister poked her head out too and asked Master-sama the same thing. Filo’s name is Filo! Um, so, apparently the world had become peaceful and Filo was having a great time with Master-sama and Mel-chan and everyone, when suddenly, like a wave, this thing called a “dungeon” appeared out of nowhere in one spot. Before that, the Dragon Hourglass had appeared too, and everyone got all worked up saying something must be going on. So Master-sama decided everyone should go check it out together, and that’s how they ended up here.

“Who knows… Our powers aren’t as all-purpose as they used to be, and if anything, this seems like something built through the world’s proper processes… I really don’t get it. Either way, nothing starts until we investigate.”

Sword Guy and Bow Guy and Spear Guy had all come along too. Master-sama got down from the carriage and went to talk with the important-looking people in charge of the place, just like he does with Mel-chan sometimes. Then he came back and it seemed like he was about to explain what they’d do next. Everyone gathered around, waiting for Master-sama’s instructions.

“Ahem… so, we’ve been asked to investigate this dungeon that suddenly appeared. Apparently, once you enter, it gets dark and everyone gets separated—that’s just how the mechanism works—but supposedly you can regroup afterward.”
“I see… that’s a bit worrying.”
“Indeed… Ren, you went in ahead of us. I’d like to hear what you found.”

“Right. Me, Éclair, and Wyndia went in to investigate. What we learned: there are shadow-like monsters inside the dungeon, there are doors partway through that let you escape, and anyone carrying a Legendary Weapon, Seven Star Weapon, or Vassal Weapon has their level and weapon reset upon entry—you can’t change forms again until you find the corresponding weapon inside the dungeon. Once you exit, the reset lifts.”
Um, Filo didn’t really get it, but it sounded like something about not being able to use claws properly anymore?
“Also, apparently for whoever’s carrying the corresponding weapon, any weapon dropped inside changes into that type.”

“So it’s some kind of hero correction thing… And the Dragon Hourglass has decorations we’ve never seen before too… What in the world is this? Also, this system sounds suspiciously familiar—what a mysterious, mystifying maze this is.”
“Maaa~ka~fu~shi~gi~”
“Filo, hush. You’re killing the mood.”
“Ehh…”
It just sounded like such a fun phrase that Filo said it, but Master-sama told her to be quiet.
“In that case, if I can’t fight properly alone, maybe it’s safest for me to just wait here?”
Just as Master-sama muttered that, Atla-chan popped out of his shield.

“Naofumi-sama, information has come through the shield from the labyrinth’s hourglass. It says that Naofumi-sama would be able to clearly see traps within the labyrinth, easily disarm them, and set them up so monsters get caught instead. Also, that he’d be able to reunite with companions quickly.”
“…Didn’t some spirits just make this place for fun or something? If so, I’m going home.”
“I thought the same and questioned them thoroughly, but even the spirits don’t seem to understand it. However… I do have concerns that this may not be a particularly good situation.”
Tch! Master-sama clicked his tongue.
“Either way, it looks like we’ll need to do a proper investigation. Everyone, that’s how it is—we’re all going into the labyrinth together to investigate.”
“Yes. Everyone, let’s go.”

Filo didn’t really get it, but it seemed like she was going into the dungeon together with Master-sama and everyone. As they pushed further and further into the cave, the bright area behind them gave way to darkness ahead. Big Sister was using light magic, and everyone else had their own lanterns too. Then, as they kept going, suddenly everything went pitch black.
“Just like they said, it’s gotten dark. Everyone, make sure to—”

And then Master-sama’s voice just cut off partway through. Right after that, the darkness lifted and it became bright again. Filo could see a cave passage—seemed a bit spacious. The claws she was holding weren’t the ones Mel-chan had taught her—they’d turned back into her very first claws.
“Master-samaaa? Where are youuu?”

Master-sama had been right there just a moment ago, right? They were supposed to get separated but be able to reunite quickly—that’s what they said. Filo sensed someone’s presence behind her. So she turned around.
“Filo-taaan!”
“It’s Spear Guy! Yaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
“Please wait, Filo-taaaaan! To think we’d be together right from the start, even though we’re supposed to get separated—this is truly the guiding hand of destiny, I say!”
“Yaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”

Filo ran with all her might, fleeing Spear Guy for dear life. Along the way she ran into some monsters, but she didn’t have time to worry about them—if she slowed down, Spear Guy would catch up—so she kicked them aside and dashed straight through.
“W-wait—”
“Yaaaaaaaaaaaa!”

Filo kept dashing down through the cave, floor after floor, for as long as it took until Spear Guy’s voice couldn’t be heard anymore. Zoom! Finally, once his voice faded away completely, she breathed a sigh of relief and looked around.
“Where am Iiii?”

Where am I~ Filo’s own voice echoed back at her… Monsters showed up in response to the sound, but Filo took them down easily with a kick. Then, there were some claws lying around, so she went to pick them up, and they got sucked right into her equipped claws. Um, these ones were stronger, so she switched to them. There was also a collar and some clothes lying around, so she picked those up too, planning to give them to Master-sama later.
“Master-samaaa!”

Ugh… where could Master-sama be~? Along the way there was a click sound and she got a little dizzy for a moment, felt kind of sick, got blown into a wall by a sudden gust of wind—Filo was getting sick of this! She wanted to see Master-sama soon! So Filo pushed on, determined. She was looking for the exit Sword Guy had mentioned. Surely Master-sama would find the exit and come out too. And as she kept moving forward…
“Sniff sniff… ah, I smell a Filolial~”

She didn’t know whose scent it was, but it was definitely a Filolial scent, different from the monsters in this cave. Since they’d said companions could regroup, she figured someone must be up ahead. So Filo headed toward the smell to reunite with them.

Then—she came out into a wide space, similar to the one she’d first been in with Spear Guy, and there was the Filolial the scent belonged to. It was cherry-blossom pink, with white-tipped feathers, and it turned to look at Filo. Ah, its eyes were the same cherry-blossom pink too. Who could it be~? A Filolial she’d never seen before, and just like Filo, it was in Queen form.
“Ah, there’s a Filolial—who are youuu?”
“Filo’s name is Filo!”
“Sakura’s name is Sakura!”

Oh really~? Seemed like this Filolial’s name was Sakura. Was it one that Spear Guy raised? Never seen it in the village before~ But Spear Guy probably raises Filolials elsewhere too, so it wasn’t strange that there’d be Filolials she’d never met.
“Where did Sakura come from~?”
“Um, so~ Sakura came with Naofumi and everyone to investigate the dungeon, and Sakura got separated~”
“Filo came with Master-sama to investigate the dungeon too, and got separated too~”
“Really~?”

Sakura seemed to be saying Master-sama’s name. Someone with the same name? Probably Master-sama, right~? Was this one Master-sama’s Filolial instead of Spear Guy’s? Would this kid recognize Master-sama, she wondered?
“Hey, have we met somewhere before~?”
“Hmm? Filo doesn’t know. Did we meet at the nest in the village~?”
“Hmm? Don’t know about a village~. What about Naofumi’s castle~?”
Master-sama has a castle~? Was it Mel-chan’s castle?
“That claw~”
“Filo’s claw~?”
Sakura was staring at Filo’s claws.
“Looks like the claw Gaelion has~”
“This is Filo’s!”
A dragon having Filo’s claws—no wayyy!
“Really~? Then maybe it’s a different one~?”
Sakura seemed to be a Filolial who didn’t know Filo at all. When Filo turned into human form, Sakura did too. Her build seemed the same as Filo’s.
“Ah, I hear a voice. Hellooo?”
A voice that sounded a lot like Master-sama’s called out. The two of them looked toward the sound, and out of the darkness came… Master-sama…?
“Ah, it’s Naofumi~”

He was carrying the same shield as Master-sama, but he looked like a kinder version of Master-sama? Filo knew that whenever Master-sama made that kind of face, he was thinking of something weird. But Master-sama was tilting his head, looking at Sakura. Is Sakura going to be okay~? When Master-sama gets like that, he ends up dragging Filo and everyone into something strange. Ah, but when he’s in a good mood he pets them too, so maybe it’s not so bad? Lately he’s had that look on his face more often. Mel-chan said she was being too cautious about it.
“Is that… Sakura-chan over there? But she’s so short, and young… about the same as Yuki-chan. Huh? Cherry-blossom colored eyes? No wait, like what Motoyasu-kun mentioned before…”
Hmm? Master-sama just called Spear Guy “-kun”?
“And the one standing next to her is the Filo-chan Motoyasu-kun told me about!? No doubt about it. She’s the spitting image of the picture he showed me before.”
Somehow this one resembled Master-sama, but something was different.
“Yep! Filo’s name is Filo!”
“R-right. But shouldn’t these two be the same person…”
“Maaa~ka~fu~shi~gi~”

“That girl looks like Sakura-chan, but she’s smaller and her eye color is different… it really is strange that a Filo-chan would be here of all places. But if I try to explain this properly and go back, who knows how Motoyasu-kun will react, he gets so scared… hmm…”
“Master-sama, are you trying to introduce Filo to Spear Guy~?”
“No, that’s not it… but according to what Gaelion-chan said, there’s a possibility that Filo-chan and Sakura-chan are actually separate individuals…?”
“Sakura is Sakura~?”
“Ah, yeah. That’s true, but… I’m just wondering what on earth is going on here… Is this labyrinth the cause after all, I wonder?”
Master-sama started muttering to himself, deep in thought.
“Looks like Master-sama but something’s different. So mystifying~ this is kind of fun!”
“Maaa~ka~fu~shi~gi~”
“Maaa~ka~fu~shi~gi~!”
“No, wait, you two are saying that with zero tension, but this isn’t really the kind of situation where you can crack a funny joke, you know?”
And so, Filo ended up reuniting in the dungeon with someone who looked like a kinder version of Master-sama, and with Sakura. For now, it seemed the three of them would be moving forward together.
April Fools' Day
